title.narrative: Improving health services access to strengthen the sustainability and quality of the national TB and HIV response - Lao (Peoples Democratic Republic) (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Lao (Peoples Democratic Republic), TB/HIV, Ministry of Health of the Lao People's Democratic Republic (MOH)This program has the following goals: Reaching the unreached to End TB in Lao PDR. End the transmission and impact of HIV/AIDS and STI in Lao PDR by 2030. The objectives of this program are: To increase the TB treatment coverage through finding and treating the missing DS-TB and DR-TB cases. To increase the uptake of TB/DR-TB preventive therapy (TPT) among eligible population. To improve the management of patients affected by drug resistant tuberculosis. To improve access to quality HIV prevention and testing services. To increase access to quality HIV treatment and care services

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for LAO-C-MOHP02
Percentage of people who completed TPT out of those who initiated TB preventive treatment
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
Percentage of people living with HIV newly initiated on ART who were screened for TB
Percentage of MSM that have received an HIV test during the reporting period in KP-specific programs and know their results
Percentage of sex workers that have received an HIV test during the reporting period in KP-specific programs and know their results
Percentage of people living with HIV and on ART with viral load test result
Percentage of people living with HIV currently enrolled on antiretroviral therapy who started TB preventive treatment (TPT) during the reporting period
Percentage of pregnant women living with HIV who received antiretroviral medicine to reduce the risk of vertical transmission of HIV
Percentage of HIV-exposed infants receiving a virological test for HIV within 2 months of birth
Percentage of people on ART among all people living with HIV at the end of the reporting period
Percentage of people living with HIV and currently on antiretroviral therapy who are receiving multi month dispensing of antiretroviral medicine
Percentage of laboratories successfully participating in external quality assurance (EQA) or proficiency testing (PT) schemes
Percentage of people with confirmed RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Percentage of molecular diagnostic analyzers achieving at least 85% functionality (ability to test samples) during the reporting period
Number of MSM who received any PrEP product at least once during the reporting period
Number of people in contact with TB patients who began preventive therapy
Number of patients with of all forms of TB notified (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed); *includes only those with new and relapse TB
